page.title: Resolution center
page.intro: Track, reply to and add evidence to your refund and damage claims. If you cannot agree, the claim is escalated to an admin.

admin.pageIntro: Review and decide claims the parties could not resolve. Chargebacks are handled by the payment provider.
admin.title: Claims

deposit.title: Damage deposit
deposit.none: This booking has no damage deposit.
deposit.expected: Expected deposit: {amount}. It is held on your card as a pre-authorization shortly before check-in.
deposit.note: The deposit is not charged; only a pre-authorization is placed. It is released at the end of the period unless a damage claim is approved.

panel.title: Damage deposit and resolution center
panel.noClaims: No claims have been opened for this booking.

open.infoGuest: If you had a problem with your stay, request a refund. The host is given time to respond; if they do not, the claim is escalated to an admin.
open.infoHost: File a claim for damage that occurred during the stay. An approved amount is captured only up to the damage deposit pre-authorization.
open.adminInfo: Admins cannot open claims; review claims from the admin panel.
open.descriptionHint: Describe what happened (10 to 4000 characters). You can add evidence after the claim is opened.
open.viewCreated: View the claim and add evidence
open.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.

detail.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw this claim? This cannot be undone.

messages.title: Messages
messages.label: Your message
messages.slaBreach: The response deadline passed; the claim was escalated to an admin.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.privacy: For your privacy, location (GPS), EXIF and all other metadata is removed from uploaded files on the server.

decision.title: Decide
decision.amountHint: Must be less than the requested amount ({amount}).
decision.invalidAmount: The partial amount must be greater than zero and less than the requested amount.
decision.pspManaged: Chargebacks are handled by the payment provider and cannot be decided here.
decision.closed: This claim is resolved; no further decision can be made.
decision.explainRefund: Approving a refund claim refunds the guest: from escrow if the funds are still held, otherwise from the host's reserve / balance after release; the platform covers any shortfall.
decision.explainDamage: Approving a damage claim captures at most the damage deposit pre-authorization; any excess is only recorded as "uncollected".

errors.CLAIM_TOO_EARLY: This type of claim cannot be opened yet (before the stay starts / ends).
errors.CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED: The window for opening a claim has closed.
errors.CLAIM_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open claim for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The amount exceeds the refundable limit (at most {amount}).
errors.CLAIM_BOOKING_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A claim cannot be opened for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_TRANSFERRED_BOOKING: For transferred bookings only the current guest can open a claim.
errors.CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LIMIT: The evidence limit for this claim has been reached.
errors.CLAIM_PSP_MANAGED: This claim is managed by the payment provider.
errors.CLAIM_CLOSED: The claim is closed; no action is possible.
errors.CLAIM_NO_PAYMENT: No captured payment was found for this booking.
errors.CLAIM_REFUND_FAILED: The refund failed; please try again later.
errors.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: Another payment operation is in progress for this booking; try again shortly.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email address before doing this.

host.title: Damage deposit
host.intro: The amount held on the guest's card as a pre-authorization before check-in. If left empty for a room type, the listing-wide amount applies.
host.tooHigh: The amount exceeds the limit (at most {amount}).
host.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
